data.one_liner: Implements WeChat SDKs in Flutter for sharing, payment, and mini programs.
data.what_it_does: Fluwx allows developers to call native WeChat SDK APIs inside Flutter applications. It supports sharing content, WeChat payments, user authentication, launching mini programs, and opening customer service.
use_when: You need to integrate WeChat payments into your Flutter application.
Your app requires WeChat social login and authentication.
You want to share content, texts, or images from your app to WeChat.
avoid_when: You do not need WeChat integration and are looking for global payment or auth gateways.
You want a zero-configuration setup, as WeChat SDK requires native configurations (Universal Links on iOS, MD5 signatures on Android).
strengths: Provides comprehensive WeChat SDK integration including pay, share, and auth.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and OpenHarmony.
Maintained with regular updates to support newer SDK versions.
weaknesses: Requires complex native setup (Universal Links, iOS SceneDelegate, Android signatures).
Breaking changes between major versions (such as v6 migrating to Swift Package Manager and KTS).
data.setup_notes: Requires manual native configurations: Universal Links, Info.plist URL schemes/Associated domains on iOS, and MD5 signature registration on Android. V6 requires Swift Package Manager configuration on iOS.

alternatives.name: pay
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need standard payment gateways like Apple Pay and Google Pay instead of WeChat Pay.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Stripe for handling payments globally rather than WeChat Pay.
